note: Per-sample audit (2026-09-30, third follow-up round) of whether this repository's own material is sufficient for a human reviewer to judge each of the 40 T3 samples. Distinguishes three separate statuses, never conflated: (1) sample_completeness_status -- does the sample record itself carry claim text + object (ticker) + a time anchor (all 40: COMPLETE); (2) source_material_completeness_status -- is there a real, structured source_registry.json for this run (none of the 40 samples' six runs have one -- all six predate the T1 source-linking chain), or only the raw TradingAgents analyst report text the claim was extracted from. All 40 claim texts were verified locatable VERBATIM (exact string match via a recursive JSON traversal, not a naive substring-on-serialized-text check, which produced false negatives on the first attempt due to JSON quote-escaping -- corrected before this final version) inside their own run's raw_agent_outputs.json/structured_agent_outputs.json/alpha_matches.json. This confirms the claim text is real and traceable to a specific agent report, but explicitly does NOT confirm the TradingAgents analyst's own underlying external source (a news article, filing, etc.) is independently verifiable from this repository alone -- finding a claim in alpha_matches.json only proves a model output existed, never that it has verified external source support or that its Alpha classification is correct; (3) human-label completion status is tracked separately in t3_human_review_form_2026-09-30.json (all 40 your_judgment fields remain null, human_review_performed=false). No source was fabricated and no claim was auto-upgraded to 'verified' beyond what is stated here. UPDATE (2026-09-30, fourth follow-up round): added alpha_judgment_feasibility per sample -- a real, code-checked distinction (does the claim open with an unresolved demonstrative pronoun lacking a clear antecedent in the extracted text) from source_material_completeness_status, which stays about external fact/source verification, never merged with it. 39/40 samples are JUDGABLE_FROM_TEXT_ALONE; 1 (prod-run-014, 'This is a major index-inclusion catalyst...') carries a caveat about its opening pronoun while remaining independently classifiable on its own stated mechanism.
